tasks.name: Land tool + registered-candidate check (authority spine)
tasks.description: Add finalizeConfirmResolution to integration.ts and the land_resolved_conflict MCP tool. The land consumes the confirm-resolution intent, requires candidateRef(guid) === intent-bound live headOid === worktreeHead, then routes through the existing finalizeAttestedCandidate (isRepair) channel - the operator keystroke over the shown diff is the review of record (D2). Lands reconcile-style (integrate + keep worktree); teardown stays the /close-out verb. The genuinely-new M6-C1-class protection is candidate PROVENANCE (registered candidate pin), NOT a reconcile equality gate (reconcile's repair branch lands any descendant by shipped design). Proven against a mechanically-seeded candidate (no apply tool yet).

steps.description: RED: in integration-cases.ts use seedRebaseConflictKind (:2141) to reach a ready_for_integration paused row, hand-resolve + rebase --continue so HEAD is a resolved candidate, write candidateRef(guid) to that HEAD. Deps via createPublicToolDependencies(db, {client, sessionId: OWNER, invocationThreadId: OWNER, source}). Assert: HAPPY (intent present, headOid===candidateRef===worktreeHead -> land returns state:'reconciled', local main advances, NO origin ref moved); S4/C4b (no intent -> throws the matching-human-intent refusal, nothing lands); S1 content-pin (candidateRef != live HEAD -> throws 'No confirmed resolution candidate matches the authorized HEAD', nothing lands). S3 REWRITE (cross-verb non-interchange + provenance): a 'reconcile' intent cannot be consumed by land_resolved_conflict (no matching confirm-resolution intent -> :612 refusal); a confirm-resolution authority cannot drive finalizeReconcile (its operation guard throws); the existing reconcile repair suite (incl. integration-cases.ts:871-908) passes byte-unchanged.
